goal: Run Guix release builds and test the resulting binaries continuously in CI
Catch build manifest breakages and signing dependency issues before release engineering
Provide automated test coverage needed for upcoming changes like fully static Linux builds
reviewability: CI is failing, so check whether the failure is caused by this PR before doing a deep review
agreement: Strong support because testing release compilation in CI catches issues earlier (fanquake)
Approach objections on duplicate builds and cache handling resolved by dropping a commit (hebasto)
Suggestion to run tests on binaries rather than only checking compilation was adopted (maflcko)
